title: Seller Fee and Invitation Expiry Figures — Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
Two receiving-side figures of the Pocketwire Personal Account are set per plan: the seller fee on goods-and-services payments received, and the expiry of payments sent to a recipient who never claims them.

| Plan | Goods-and-services seller fee (percent of the payment received) | Unclaimed payment expiry (calendar days after sending) |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 2.99 | 14 |
| Pocketwire Core | 2.99 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 2.99 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 2.49 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 2.29 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Summit | 1.99 | 30 |

- **Goods-and-services seller fee** — the seller fee on a goods-and-services payment received into a personal account, as a percentage of the payment amount.
- **Unclaimed payment expiry** — the calendar days after sending after which a payment to a recipient who never claimed it is refunded.

On Pocketwire Lite an unclaimed payment expires after 14 days; on every other plan after 30 days. The seller fee is 2.99 percent up to Pocketwire Plus and lower on each plan above it.
